Officers in State Service get appointed to All India Services like Indian Administrative Service, Indian Police Service and Indian Forest Service, by promotion or by selection, as per the provisions in the Rules read 1<sup>st</sup> to 3<sup>rd</sup> above. On their appointment to All India Services, their pay has to be fixed in accordance with relevant pay rules applicable to the respective service during the time of their appointment in All India Service. The pay revisions in Central Government Service and State Government Service differ in distinct manners like the tenure of revision, date of effect, rate of DA merged with revised scales of pay, etc. Therefore, while fixing the pay of officers in the All India Service as per the pay rules concerned consequent on their induction into All India Service, various factors like date of effect of existing pay revisions in the State and Centre, DA sanctioned on the date of pay fixation, excess benefits received in the State pay as part of State Pay Revision after the last Central Pay Revision, service rendered in State Civil Service/State Service, date of allotment-etc. need to be considered and
